prompt:
The attached contact is the canonical source plus current six views for two distinct Dark-style game props. Create ONE transparent pixel-art atlas with exactly SIX equal columns x TWO equal rows. Columns left to right are FRONT, TOP, RIGHT, LEFT, BOTTOM, REAR; rows are, in order, over-city-venues-tavern-bar then race-circuits-pit-service-grating-floor. No labels/text. Each cell contains one complete centered object with generous transparent gutters, consistent scale within its own row, no clipping or spill. Use axis-aligned orthographic cameras only, no perspective or isometric. Preserve each source's identity, counts, palette and pixel-art outline. All unshown surfaces are modest inferences.

ROW 1 — Tavern bar: retain the source's wooden bar/counter and shelf, barrel, bottles, and exactly three red stool assemblies. TOP is genuinely overhead: the counter worktop, shelf top/crown and barrel top; three separate round stool-seat tops, with stool legs hidden by the seats/counter. BOTTOM is the full opaque wooden/bar underside plus three stool foot/seat underside footprints in correct positions, no upright legs. REAR is the opposite back elevation of the wooden bar: a solid wooden shelf/back panel with supports, no repeated frontal bottle row; keep three stool legs/assemblies if visible from that side. Maintain a physically coherent horizontal bar axis across these views.

ROW 2 — Pit service grating floor: this is a flat, square, perforated metal floor grate. Keep its exact dark gray metal frame and regular square mesh. TOP and BOTTOM are already established in the contact and should be represented faithfully as full open mesh/square views. FRONT, RIGHT, LEFT, and REAR are low edge-on elevations of the thin horizontal grate: show only the narrow metal frame edge, mesh edge thickness and small feet/rim where visible. Do NOT show rows of large upward-facing rectangular grating openings in any side elevation. Sides are horizontal thin strips with camera at exact level; no diamond/isometric upper plane.

For all rows, use transparent background, crisp source-matched pixel-art material and outlines, orthographic six-view camera convention, and no unrelated props or neighboring cell fragments.
